creative_genome.body: An editorial index system that reduces choice overload without presenting competitor performance as fact.

creative_genome.targetAudience: D.C. adults 21+ seeking a fast, legible evening discovery path
creative_genome.visualConcept: An original editorial arch and constellation index.
